result.rationale: Small intact friction blister on an otherwise healthy 8-year-old with no signs of infection (no redness, pus, fever) and normal walking; request is for general protective care advice. Appropriate for self-care: leave blister intact, cover with a padded bandage/moleskin, avoid the offending shoes, keep clean; seek care if redness, pus, fever, spreading pain, or difficulty walking develops.
